text:
The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm. It holds three pieces of white fish fillet, probably steamed or pan-cooked, plus a portion of cooked bok choy.

The fish pieces are roughly 8x5 cm each and thin. That is about 40-50 g per piece, so around 130 g in total. At about 1.3 kcal/g for cooked white fish with a little oil, that comes to about 170 kcal.

The bok choy is about 80-100 g and adds about 15-20 kcal, or perhaps 30 kcal with oil.

Together that is roughly 225 g of food and about 200 kcal.
